title: Boundary geometry and concentration points for attractive Bose-Einstein condensates with a ring-shaped potential
summary: In this paper, we study the ground states of attractive Bose-Einstein condensates in a bounded domain $Ω\subset \mathbb R^2$ under the ring-shaped trapping potential $$ V(x)=(|x|-1)^2. $$ The boundary geometry of $Ω$ may allow the ring $Γ=\{x\in\mathbb R^2:|x|=1\}$ of global minima for $V(x)$ to meet both the interior and the boundary of $Ω$. As the interaction strength approaches the critical value, we prove that if $Γ\cap Ω\not=\emptyset$, the mass of ground states concentrates at a point $x_0\inΓ\cap Ω$ that has maximal distance from $\partialΩ$.
